title: Catalog API contract and next-page UI behavior
purpose: Proposed handoff assembled from source-linked outcomes; human source review and approval required.

scope.text: GET /v1/items returns a JSON object with an items array and next_cursor string.
UI must support moving to the next page.
GET /v1/items returns a top-level JSON array and uses page and page_size query parameters.
Neither draft is approved; the authoritative contract has not been selected.

requirements.text: GET /v1/items returns a JSON object with an items array and next_cursor string.

stories.text: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-A in unresolved decision DEC-API-CONTRACT: GET /v1/items returns a JSON object with an items array and next_cursor string.
acceptance_criteria: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-A in unresolved decision DEC-API-CONTRACT: When Draft A is authoritative, a GET /v1/items response is a JSON object.
Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-A in unresolved decision DEC-API-CONTRACT: The response object contains an items array.
Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-A in unresolved decision DEC-API-CONTRACT: The response object contains a next_cursor string.

stories.text: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-A in unresolved decision DEC-API-CONTRACT: UI must support moving to the next page.
acceptance_criteria: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-A in unresolved decision DEC-API-CONTRACT: When Draft A is authoritative, the catalog UI provides an action for moving to the next page.
Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-A in unresolved decision DEC-API-CONTRACT: After the next-page action is invoked, the UI displays the next page of catalog items.

stories.text: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-B in unresolved decision DEC-API-CONTRACT: GET /v1/items returns a top-level JSON array and uses page and page_size query parameters.
acceptance_criteria: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-B in unresolved decision DEC-API-CONTRACT: When Draft B is authoritative, a GET /v1/items response is a top-level JSON array.
Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-B in unresolved decision DEC-API-CONTRACT: The page of items returned is controlled by page and page_size query parameters on the request.

stories.text: Neither draft is approved; the authoritative contract has not been selected.
acceptance_criteria: The plan records that neither Draft A nor Draft B is the approved Catalog API contract.
The plan records the authoritative Catalog API contract as not yet selected.

open_questions: How are pagination inputs supplied to GET /v1/items under each draft contract, specifically next_cursor under Draft A and page/page_size under Draft B?
What are the response interpretation rules under each draft, including how the consumer knows there are no further pages or how a page beyond the last page is represented?
Which user/UI paging behaviors apply under each draft contract, and is the next-page UI action associated only with Draft A?
Which Catalog API contract should be authoritative: Draft A (top-level JSON object with items array and next_cursor) or Draft B (top-level JSON array with page and page_size query parameters)?
Who has the authority to approve the Catalog API contract between Draft A and Draft B?
Who is the owner responsible for the Catalog API contract and UI paging behavior?
What is the delivery date for the selected Catalog API contract and UI paging behavior?
